overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief meeting on August 25th, approving several routine items including selection of Clark Dietz for a sanitary sewer capacity assessment study, a large pay estimate for lead service line replacement, a street construction pay estimate, and a concrete contractor license. The meeting concluded quickly with no notable debate.
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not identified by name in transcript

agenda.item: Item 1: Approval of minutes of the preceding meeting
Item 2A: Recommendation for sanitary sewer capacity assessment and flow monitoring study
Item 2B: Pay Estimate #33 – Community Infrastructure Partners, lead service line replacement
Item 2C: Pay Estimate #5 – Stark Street (2026 Street Construction Project A), Switlick and Sons
Item 2D: Portland cement concrete license – Antler Concrete

discussions.body: A motion was made and seconded to approve the minutes of the preceding meeting. The motion passed on a voice vote with no discussion.

discussions.item: Sanitary sewer capacity assessment and flow monitoring study – vendor selection
discussions.body: Staff reported that three proposals were received from HDR, Clark Dietz, and Strand, and that four staff members evaluated them. Scores were described as close but Clark Dietz scored highest. A motion was made by a board member to approve Clark Dietz for the study, seconded, and approved unanimously on a voice vote with no further debate.

discussions.item: Pay Estimate #33 – Lead service line replacement (Community Infrastructure Partners)
discussions.body: A pay estimate of $602,642.35 was presented for lead service line replacement construction work. Staff noted the project remains on schedule and is expected to close the following day, August 26th. The motion to approve was made, seconded, and passed unanimously on a voice vote.

discussions.item: Pay Estimate #5 – Stark Street, 2026 Street Construction Project A (Switlick and Sons)
discussions.body: A pay estimate of $596,518.20 from Switlick and Sons for the Stark Street portion of the 2026 street construction project was presented. A motion to approve was made and seconded; the item passed on a voice vote with no discussion.

discussions.item: Portland cement concrete license – Antler Concrete
discussions.body: A license application and bond from Antler Concrete for Portland cement concrete work was reviewed. A board member indicated they had reviewed the materials and moved to approve the application and bond; the motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a voice vote.

actionItems: Clark Dietz selected and approved to conduct the sanitary sewer capacity assessment and flow monitoring study
Pay Estimate #33 for $602,642.35 to Community Infrastructure Partners for lead service line replacement approved
Pay Estimate #5 for $596,518.20 to Switlick and Sons for Stark Street (2026 Street Construction Project A) approved
Portland cement concrete license and bond for Antler Concrete approved
Lead service line replacement project scheduled to close August 26, 2025

votes.item: Approval of minutes of the preceding meeting
Sanitary sewer capacity assessment and flow monitoring study – award to Clark Dietz
Pay Estimate #33 – Community Infrastructure Partners, lead service line replacement, $602,642.35
Pay Estimate #5 – Switlick and Sons, Stark Street, $596,518.20
Portland cement concrete license and bond – Antler Concrete
votes.motion: Move to approve their application and bond

title: Wausau Board of Public Works Meeting
